subject: prd/workbench-ui
statement: When rendering a document containing corpus citation grammars, the reading room shall render each citation as navigation resolving to the cited document and anchor; an unresolvable citation shall render as named-unresolved.
rationale: provenance is the doc system's spine; hand-resolving it is the toil
fit_criterion: fixture docs: each grammar class resolves to its target anchor; a dangling citation renders named-unresolved and is never silently plain text
